0dda8eb3-3287-5bb6-9b26-b1c00cc038d9.content: Conduct one review prior to submission focusing solely on the validity of user problems, design interventions, and evaluation logic.

c8e0c9dd-dc4a-5a7d-9a82-e7ee449a4b25.content: Cross-check whether research questions align with the core functions of the prototype.

f93c5baa-3c2b-5e37-b07b-0b00e8b22ab9.content: Cross-check whether evaluation tasks align with representative measures.

8dae0ad6-2a6d-5d99-98db-b0d48a1140e5.content: Cross-check whether collected evidence aligns with design and operational decisions to be changed.

0f89ab25-d9ee-5669-aa99-a0fe07803915.content: Verify at the end that user problems, design interventions, user studies, and expected contributions form a coherent logical flow.

3e4a9a3b-abc2-54ed-9b87-f81abf61b541.content: HCI reviewers view the validity of design interventions as low if research questions are not linked to prototype functions.

fb785649-1947-5e7d-aafb-308f14fb21b4.content: HCI reviewers view the validity of evaluation plans as low if evaluation tasks do not produce representative measures.

02f8ddd8-32b0-5e3b-b358-5e0472a6e0d2.content: HCI reviewers view the practicality of contributions as low if collected evidence cannot change design or operational decisions.

d17ba26c-187e-57bc-8468-c9c053fc303d.content: Cross-check at the end whether each research question, formative evaluation data, and design modification judgment are seamlessly connected.

48a91d19-cc68-5400-8971-8125236f3fbf.content: Review whether the application conditions of proposed design principles and boundary cases of failure are presented together.

774341c9-b92d-53a5-a24c-59c75e39756b.content: The agent can review contributions only if prototype outcomes and the transferable design knowledge derived from them are separated.

877015ae-ab0b-561c-9fe3-3abb2d0aaa4e.content: The scope of observation in controlled formative evaluations does not include long-term adaptation and operational changes in real-world usage contexts.
